# Spiritual Lesson Plans

> Free, Creative Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) Sunday school and youth-group lesson plans rooted in
> Christian Science and the Bible, explicitly open to every faith background. Each lesson is
> written independently for the age it's delivered to — not simplified down from one script —
> across five age bands from early elementary through adult, plus a printable handout per lesson.

Written for Christian Science Sunday school teachers and other Christian educators looking for
free, spiritually grounded, developmentally appropriate discussion and activity lessons. No
account, no cost, no organization — nothing here teaches original sin or a scorekeeping God; the
premise underneath every lesson is that a young person is already whole and already loved. All
content is free to use, adapt, and share under CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Lessons

- [Does God Make My Decisions For Me?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/does-god-make-my-decisions): A practical way to move through the toughest choices. (11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Finding the Bigger "Us"](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/finding-the-bigger-us): A practical way to stop picking sides. (5–8, 8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Is God Keeping Score?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/is-god-keeping-score): Why the God you were handed might not be the God who’s actually there — and what changes the moment you switch pictures. (5–8, 8–11, 11–14, 21+)
- [Is Regret a Fair and Just Teacher?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/is-regret-a-fair-teacher): A practical path from a hard decision to moving forward — without pretending it didn’t happen. (11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [LGBTQIA+ Youth and Spiritual Learning](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/lgbtqia-youth-and-spiritual-learning): Is there anyone in the world who shouldn’t have access to Truth? A lesson on belonging that works whether you’re figuring out your own identity or a friend’s. (14–21)
- [Learning to Hear the Nudge](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/learning-to-hear-the-nudge): A lesson on inner guidance — distinguishing genuine nudges from anxious noise, with practice on small decisions. (8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Lonely in a Crowded Room](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/lonely-in-a-crowded-room): What that ache is actually telling you — and what’s still true underneath it. (8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Off Days Are Allowed](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/off-days-are-allowed): Feeling disconnected doesn’t mean you’re doing it wrong. (5–8, 8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Seven Names, One Journey](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/seven-synonyms-and-three-degrees): Two of Christian Science’s most foundational ideas, unpacked for anyone — no faith background, and no prior exposure to Christian Science, required. (5–8, 8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Soul: Another Name for God](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/soul-another-name-for-god): Reading, symbolism, a creative class definition, and real life — Soul as one of the seven synonyms for God in Christian Science. (11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Talking About the Increase of Pornography Use in Our World](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/talking-about-pornography-use): “A steady, shame-free way in — because a habit is a cloud passing in front of the sun, not the sun itself.” (14–21)
- [The Pull You Feel — In Tune or Out?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/the-pull-you-feel): Attraction isn’t the villain and it isn’t the boss — this lesson gives you a real test for what’s actually running it. (11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Trust the Mover](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/trust-the-mover): What to do with real disappointment when your plans fall apart. (5–8, 8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [When Someone Feels Like the Enemy](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/when-someone-feels-like-the-enemy): Why “love your enemies” isn’t the same as “there are no enemies.” (8–11, 11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [Words That Open Doors](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/words-that-open-doors): Old language, old thoughts — and making the sacred make sense today. (11–14, 14–21, 21+)
- [You Are Not the Struggle](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/not-the-struggle): Can you be uncomfortable — and still be whole? Same paradox at every age, anchored in the performance anxiety of trying to seem like you have it together. (11–14, 14–21, 21+)

## Optional

- [For Mentors](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/for-mentors): facilitator safety guidelines and how the age-band system works
- [What We Believe](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/what-we-believe): plain-language explainer on Christian Science, including how it differs from the doctrine of original sin
- [About](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/about): what this project is and its licensing
